title: Consarc and Winston — reserving formal execution
shortTitle: Consarc and Winston — reserving formal execution
summary: The notes identify evidence bearing on whether an unsigned or informal agreement is already binding.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The discussion considers reservation of a signed writing, partial performance, whether all terms are settled, and whether the transaction usually receives a formal document. The factors organize interpretation; they do not mechanically create an obligation in every negotiation.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 188–190. Open assigned page 188.
